verdict.rationale: Yapily publishes a full REST API reference (accounts, transactions, payments, authorisations), documented HTTP Basic Auth, an OpenAPI spec for client-library generation, and webhooks for async status — all core requirements for an AI-native user to programmatically drive the product. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the OpenAPI spec (probe found expected openapi.json paths 404) and third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs.
